scope: Files specified by the instrument guide and named analytical products. A shared ledger can be updated in more than one stage. Reading URLs resolve relative to the stage page.

groups.description: adaptations.jsonl collects the validated return lines with their evidence and model version. "Validated" means the required structural checks passed; the aggregator rules on each claim in D3.
verdicts-D.jsonl keeps the readers' fit judgments and reasons beside the community coders' assessments. Each reading stays visible, with no vote between them.

groups.purpose: The local accounts and comparison table
groups.description: rooms/<sub>/model-D.md holds each returned local account, with its verdict-D record beside it. _views/rooms-x-elements.tsv sets communities against model elements, so D3 can read all the evidence on one claim together.

groups.purpose: What arrived, failed or remains missing
groups.description: ingest-D.md reports accepted lines, failed rules and missing communities. notes-D2.md records the sample checks and cautions on substance. RUN.json records return counts; run_manifest.json records the models used. handback-D2.md carries defects and open operational questions forward.
